description.en: The ID of the database. You can call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) API to obtain this ID.

descriptions.zh: 查询表的业务知识/使用说明，返回 AI 增强业务描述、表业务摘要、关联资产列表，用于辅助语义找表与表用法说明
descriptions.en: Retrieves usage instructions and business context for a table. This operation returns an AI-enhanced business description, a table summary, and a list of related assets. This information helps you find tables semantically and understand their usage.
